entries.groups.producer.title: The producer's mapping, not a sealed record
entries.groups.tier.judged.title: Decided by a pinned model applying a frozen rubric
entries.groups.tier.recomputed.title: A fixed check anyone can repeat from the records
entries.groups.ob.ok.unverified: No exceptions found · {unverified} could not be verified
entries.groups.row.nothing: Not checked: no session has a result
entries.groups.row.unverified-note: {n} could not be verified (failed verification or evidence missing)
entries.groups.summary.h: What was checked and what we found
entries.groups.summary.lede: Each session (one conversation with the agent) was checked against {tests} under {obligations}. Results are counts of sessions: there is no overall score. Open a test to read the sessions behind its exceptions.
entries.groups.summary.basis: Every count and result is read from the sealed claims and reports in this bundle, or marked "not stated". The regulation named in the heading, obligation titles, test names, the article, the plain-language summary, applicability, method, finding ids, severities, recommendations and the notes on undecided tests and quality checks are the producer's mapping, set in italics: carried beside the signed records, not in them.
entries.groups.drill.unverified: Show the {sessions} that could not be verified
entries.groups.drill.undecided: Show the {sessions} that could not be decided
entries.groups.unverified-note: no verdict drawn: neither met nor an exception
entries.groups.pf.case-record.from-claims: {record} (cited by every claim of this session; the reports that name it are withheld)
entries.groups.pf.no-claim: no claim: Result v0 carries none for a test that did not apply
entries.groups.rp.toggle: Proofs for this report: method, test wording, what ran, and how to verify the whole bundle
entries.groups.od.h: Method and the wording each test ran
entries.groups.od.mapped: Title, article, summary, method, test names and the undecided-session note: the producer's mapping, in italics, not a sealed record.
entries.groups.od.unmapped: The producer's extension does not map this obligation: article, summary and method not stated.
entries.groups.od.wording.mixed: Wording not stated: the cited reports state different wordings.
entries.groups.od.wording.unstated: Wording not stated: no cited report states it.
entries.groups.q.none: No quality protocol declared in this pack.
entries.groups.vd.note: This bundle's own checkpoint, an append-only Merkle Mountain Range over the sealed records. Repeat every check on this page offline with the open-source verifier. This page only ever renders a bundle that already verified: tamper with any claim, record or checkpoint and the whole page is replaced by the verification-failed banner.
entries.judge.note.sure: The judge gave this verdict a probability of {p}%.
entries.case.label: task {task}
entries.chat.absent: The conversation is not in this bundle. It is sealed in the case record {record}, which this report does not disclose, so this page cannot show it.
entries.chat.not-shown.default-reason: the transcript in this bundle does not check against the case the judge read
entries.chat.lede: {messages} messages, {calls}. {state} Tool results are shown as sealed; JSON is only indented, and only where indenting changes nothing else. Tool arguments are shown as the report model hands them over, re-serialised, so a number JSON cannot hold exactly may already be rounded.
entries.chat.state.cited: The conversation of the case every claim cites. The judge's reports are withheld, so which conversation the judge read is not shown.
entries.chat.state.verified: The exact conversation the judge read, checked on this page (see the proofs).
entries.report.basis.source: source says (backfilled record; the source's own timestamp, self-attested)
entries.report.basis.judged: the day the judgments were sealed (no case record date to read)
entries.report.dating.source: Dates are the source's own timestamps for backfilled records ("source says"), as given, not when the records were sealed.
entries.report.dating.record: The period is when the conversations happened (each case record's own time, as given), not when they were judged.
entries.report.dating.mixed: Dates are each conversation's own date, as given, not when the judgments were sealed:
entries.report.dating.mixed.source: {n} backfilled by the source's own timestamp ("source says");
entries.report.dating.mixed.record: {n} by the case record's own timestamp;
entries.report.dating.mixed.judged: {n} with no case record date to read, by the day they were judged.
entries.report.dating.self-attested: A backfilled record's source time is self-attested: carrying it does not make it witnessed.
entries.report.dating.tz: Timezone not stated on {count} of {total}; no zone is assumed.
entries.report.proofs.toggle: Proofs: record ids, digests and the judge pin
entries.report.gap.notes.withheld: The judge's notes are not in this bundle: its reports are withheld.
entries.report.gap.notes.unread: The judge's notes are not shown: some reports in this bundle do not match what was sealed, cannot be read, or do not check out.
entries.report.gap.notes.some-withheld: The judge's notes are not in this bundle: some of its reports are withheld.
entries.report.pf.input-digest.verified: {digest} (the transcript's digest equals what the judged case committed to, checked on this page)
entries.report.pf.input-digest.cited: {digest} (the case every claim cites; the judge's reports are withheld, so which conversation the judge read is not shown)
entries.report.pf.wording.default: wording pack {id}, built into this viewer
entries.report.pf.wording.supplied: wording pack {id}, supplied with the page (wording_sha256 {sha256})
entries.report.pin.withheld: the judge's reports that state it are withheld ({count} of {total})
entries.report.pin.unread: {count} of {total} reports in this bundle do not match what was sealed, cannot be read, or do not check out
entries.prov.judge.label: Judged by
entries.prov.judge.none: not stated: no result in this bundle cites a report
entries.prov.judge.model.does-not-recompute: model not shown (the model the reports state does not recompute to the pin)

entries.prov.judge.model.partly-stated: model not shown (some reports with this pin state no model)
entries.prov.judge.all-withheld: not in this bundle: the judge's reports are withheld ({of})
entries.prov.judge.some-withheld: the reports for {of} results are withheld, so their judge is not in this bundle
entries.prov.judge.not-carried: the reports for {of} results are not in this bundle, so their judge is not stated
entries.prov.judge.unread: {of} reports do not match what was sealed, cannot be read, or do not check out
entries.prov.witness.label: Witnessed by
entries.prov.witness.stated: {witnesses}: stated by the bundle, not checked here.
entries.prov.witness.none: not stated in this bundle: it carries no witness receipt for its checkpoint.
entries.prov.witness.about.unchecked: The checkpoint: {facts}; this page did not check its signature.
entries.prov.witness.about.unsigned: The checkpoint: {facts}; the bundle carries no signature for it.

entries.prov.verifier.ran.cll: this page's code: {viewer} {viewerVersion} at {commit}, verifier {verifier} {verifierVersion} with cll {cll}
entries.prov.verifier.ran.not-stated: this page's code; its viewer and verifier versions are not stated
